title: Supply convoy grounded on route
prompt: Create one complete 16:9 documentary image for CAMP CENTURY. Images1 and2 establish the OWNER-APPROVED style: confident detailed ink and charcoal linework, restrained watercolor, paper tooth, blue-white snow, olive winter clothes, sparse rusty ochre objects. Match those images, not a new design system. Full finished composition, large explanatory drawing, legible short English labels integrated into the scene/paper. Create a fresh full-frame, human-centered supply scene matching the approved period tracked tractor and orange sled in source image3. The complete tractor and one connected cargo sled are INTEGRATED into the same scene and physically sit on one clearly compacted, continuous snow route. Vehicle faces diagonally toward the LEFT foreground and sled follows BEHIND it to the RIGHT midground; taut short towbar joins tractor rear and sled front. Both tracks and both sled runners follow the SAME parallel travel direction and contact the packed road. Road runs coherently from LEFT foreground toward RIGHT distance, with matching track grooves, long low snow berms, no deep ruts across its path. Two winter-clad Army workers stand safely on the far shoulder, not in the vehicle path. Low oblique camera, no mountains or ocean. Full natural drawn environment, period olive-grey tractor and rusty orange sled, correct grounding/shadows, no floating composited cutouts. NO text. This will be animated by a small coherent camera approach, not by sliding an object across the snow. All base artwork must be CLEAN: NO yellow highlighting, NO underlines, NO marker strokes, NO selection circles, NO loupes, NO glow or animated accents baked into the image; those are added later in DaVinci Resolve. No generic three-line title card, UI, HUD, floating boxes, fake official seals/signatures/stamps, tiny filler text, placeholders, empty panels, decorative noise or burnt parchment. Use 6 percent safe margins. This is authored explanatory artwork, not an original archival record. No invented quantities, dimensions or measurement curves. No other projects or bases. Text only as explicitly specified.
